lede: Jensen Huang has stepped down as Nvidia's chief executive, and the story swamped the day: he topped Wikipedia with 727,529 views while the news wire tracked the stock fallout and Polymarket opened bets on his return. The other loud item was a nationwide FAA ground stop, lifted after about 4.5 hours, which pulled 1,467 points on Hacker News. The largest tremor on the planet was a magnitude 5.8 quake off Changuillo, Peru.

throughlines.title: Jensen Huang
throughlines.gist: Huang's exit as Nvidia CEO drove 727,529 Wikipedia views and carried from the news wire to Polymarket, where traders are already pricing whether he rejoins by month's end.

throughlines.title: Nvidia Allegedly Engineered Scarcity by Funding AI Startups to Buy Its GPUs
throughlines.gist: A report alleging Nvidia funded AI startups to buy its own chips and manufacture scarcity lit up Hacker News and Mastodon at once, a pointed counter-note to the departure story.

throughlines.title: Show HN: Live map of U.S. flights during tonight's FAA nationwide ground stop
throughlines.gist: With the FAA's nationwide ground stop halting departures, a developer's live flight map spread across Hacker News and Lemmy as people watched the skies empty.
